The demolitionist is a mask with a lot of explosives. They're great at a lot of things - causing distractions, property damage, and murder - but their explosives are limited and obvious. Their cache contains two explosive grenades, 3 C-4 charges, a syndicate bomb, and a micro-bomb implant.
### C4 Blows up whatever is on the tile it's on, and not much else. Great for breaching, but not that good at damaging players. Must be planted to arm; cannot be manually activated like other explosives.
### Explosive Grenade Highly versatile and great for dealing massive damage to players in a pinch. Though it can sometimes do okay damage to weak structures like machines and windows, it's much better used as an offensive tool.
### Syndicate Bomb A loud stationary bomb with a 60-second-long fuse that creates a gigantic explosion. It's strong enough to definitively render entire rooms unusable until extensive repairs are done.
### Micro-bomb Implant An implant that creates a medium-sized explosion upon the user's death. It deals a huge amount of damage upon death - enough to instantly send anyone caught in to the radius in to critical condition.
